content: Official Godot stable documentation supplies ENet high-level RPC authority and channels, replicated primitive properties, and headless execution. MultiplayerSynchronizer does not synchronize Object or Resource properties or peer-specific instance IDs. Recommend explicit validated host commands and versioned snapshot/delta DTOs for inventory and late join; reserve synchronizers for presentation. Input.ParseInputEvent traverses game input but not OS focus, requiring additional rendered OS-input checks. Context7 and ctx7 unavailable; searched and cross-checked direct official documentation on 2026-11-13. Sources: https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/networking/high_level_multiplayer.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_multiplayersynchronizer.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_input.html https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/tutorials/export/exporting_for_dedicated_servers.html
